text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A bomb explosion kills two people and wounds six in a restaurant at Staoueli, near Algiers.
- The government, workers union and employers organisations agree to reduce working hours from 44 hours to 40 hours weekly and raise school allowances.
- African Youth Movement holds congress in Algiers on Sunday.
- Political parties await President Liamine Zeroual's decision on political reforms to reshape multi-party rules.
